Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus

Condominium in Bang Tao / Choeng Thale (Laguna Phuket)
HomeSaleBellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium within Laguna Phuket, overlooking the Laguna Golf Phuket course near Bang Tao Beach. It forms part of Bellaguna Golf Residences, which comprises five interconnected finger-shaped low-rise buildings. Layouts range from one to three bedrooms plus two- and three-bedroom penthouses, with four shared pools. Select ground-floor residences have private pools or gardens.

Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus: key facts

  • Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Laguna Property (Banyan Group).
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 67–297 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Oct 2029.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿11,800,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (1.1 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Phuket International Airport (about 25 minutes, driving); Bang Tao Beach (1.1 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (4.1 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (7.5 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Laguna Property in our catalogue: Laguna Lake Residences Aster, Laguna Park 2.

  • Four free-form swimming pools with terraces
